name: cp_lime
subject: a tall park lime tree (linden) in golden autumn, seen from the front: a straight grey-brown trunk with vertical bark ridges and a slightly flared foot, three main limbs forking up into one big rounded mass of autumn leaves in large clumps, warm golden yellow and orange with a few amber-red clumps, small gaps between the clumps where dark branches show, lit from the upper left so each clump has a bright yellow top edge and a deeper orange-brown underside
part_map: the dark grey column is the trunk (exactly that width and height, it touches the ground line), the mid grey bars are the main limbs going up into the crown, the big light grey shape is the leafy crown: fill it to its edge with irregular leaf clumps on the outline, keep the underside at that height, and let the crown run out of the top edge of the image, cut by the frame like a big tree seen close up.
size_sentence: the trunk is about as wide as the dog's head is tall, and the lowest leaves hang about two and a half dog heights above the ground. It is a big old park tree, far taller than the image, so its top is not seen.

slot.where: City Park tall, the climbed limes: screen 6 (trunk x 1528, and the ash slot x 1916), drawn by Sc.drawTreetops over the old canopy boxes
